name: Halit Bozkurt
about: I am Halit, born in 1999, living in Trabzon. I have been interested in graphic design, photography, and video editing. I once created and managed a YouTube channel. By streaming on mobile apps, I built a strong community. I enjoy writing rap songs and performing them live. I believe in the energy of music and often lose myself in it while listening. My native language is Turkish, I speak English at a conversational level, and I am currently learning Indonesian.
